answer: Retrospective overlap-plume detection. Each agent action emits a timestamped embedding signal; post hoc, auditors cluster signals by trajectory overlap—distinct agents rarely share identical timing, tool-call sequences, and resource-draw patterns. Sybil clusters leave a dense plume of near-duplicate trajectories. Accounts inside a flagged plume are quarantined in a low-trust harbor pending independent re-verification, and their accrued rewards are deferred, not paid.
